paper_id: GenPTW_ Latent Image Watermarking for Provenance Tracing and Tamper Localization
title: GenPTW: Latent Image Watermarking for Provenance Tracing and Tamper Localization
motivation: 生成式图像模型普及带来内容溯源和篡改检测需求，现有方法或无法定位篡改或受限于特定生成设置
problem_framing: 将 provenance tracing 和 tamper localization 统一在单一潜空间水印嵌入中，同时支持 in-generation 和 post-hoc
key_insight: 通过 cross-attention fusion 让水印随潜表征演化并对齐语义，通过 spatial fusion 在最终解码层注入像素级空间先验
method_signature: CAF+SF 双模块潜空间嵌入 + tamper-aware extractor 联合水印解码与篡改定位
evaluation_criteria: 视觉保真度(PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS)、水印位准确率、篡改定位F1/AUC
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 全局语义重写(如InstructP2P)因彻底改变结构模型将整图标记为篡改,这是优先保真的设计权衡
evidence_for_taste: optimal balance between robustness and perceptual quality
consistent with the evidence in Table 4
enhances spatial alignment and local sensitivity
thinking_moves: 统一两个独立任务于单一embedding中
用spatial fusion在最终层注入pixel-level spatial prior
joint watermark features + high-frequency features做multi-modal fusion
coarse-to-fine hierarchical embedding across decoder stages
